Founding terms, until 31 January 2027

The first five paying clients get 50% off the first month of one monthly plan, or 15% off one fixed package. After delivery you're asked for a short debrief and

step0.text:
Brief

Tell us about your business, your customers and the platforms you use. Links to your pages and a few photos help.

step1.text:
Propose

You get a written proposal with the plan, platforms, price and roles. Nothing starts until you agree.

step2.text:
Make

Each month’s batch of posts, plus the newsletter on Plus, is drafted and sent for approval by the 25th, with one consolidated round of changes.

step3.text:
Deliver

Approved posts are scheduled and the newsletter goes out. Plus includes a monthly report. Cancel with 30 days’ notice.

faq1.text:
Do I have to approve every post?

Yes. Nothing is posted or sent until you approve the monthly batch. One consolidated round of changes is included per batch.

Which platforms are covered?
